# HumanPush

> Pilot. AI agents request the work and the signature of a NIVRE-registered claims expert through HumanPush. The company pays 100% upfront. The signed work comes back with proof that anyone can check independently.

People use https://humanpush.nl. This file is for agents and lives at https://humanpush.nl/llms.txt.

What works now is the sandbox. Production is a pilot and opens with a small group in early 2027. Netherlands first. The sandbox uses pretend money and a pretend register. The sandbox clock runs faster than real time, so poll get_status.

## Sandbox

- Get a key: https://mcp.humanpush.nl/
- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.humanpush.nl/mcp
- The endpoint asks for the sandbox key.
- Public keys for the signatures: https://mcp.humanpush.nl/.well-known/humanpush-keys.json

## What it does

An agent asks a registered professional to do the work and sign it. HumanPush checks the registration in the public register. It does not judge the quality of the work. It is not part of NIVRE, NRVT or Rbtv.

The pilot is for NIVRE-registered claims experts. The sandbox catalog also lists an NRVT property valuer and an Rbtv sworn translator, so those calls can be tried on pretend data.

Under the AVG (article 22) a person can have a right to human intervention in certain decisions based solely on automated processing. HumanPush is how an agent asks a registered claims expert to do that work and sign it.

## When to use HumanPush

- A claims decision needs a registered claims expert to review it and sign.
- You must rely on that signature and need proof that can be checked independently.
- You need to confirm that a person is listed in the public NIVRE register.

## When not to use HumanPush

- The work does not need a registered signer.
- You want a judgement of quality. HumanPush checks registration, not quality.
- Notarial deeds. Those go through the Dutch notarial system.
- Consumers. HumanPush is for companies.

## Tools

These are the sandbox calls. They run on pretend data and pretend money. A write call takes an idempotency_key. The same key does not run the action twice.

Usual order: list_services, then request_signoff, then poll get_status. After a delivery: respond_to_result, then get_result, then verify_proof. Upload documents with create_upload_url when the work needs files. Read the log with get_events.

### list_services

Return the fixed catalog of services per register, with terms, a price range, lead times and the professionals who offer each service. Call this before request_signoff.

- input: register, profession, region or language, all optional. Sandbox registers: NIVRE, NRVT, Rbtv.
- output: services, each with a service_id, the terms, a price range and the professionals
- price: Price on request
- sandbox: pretend catalog, free

### verify_professional

Check one person against one official register right now.

- input: register (NIVRE, NRVT or Rbtv) and registration_number. as_of is optional. The sandbox register has no history.
- output: registered true or false, the status, and a signed attestation
- sandbox: pretend register, free

### create_upload_url

Get a one-time URL and upload one document with HTTP PUT (raw bytes). Pass the document_id to request_signoff.

- input: idempotency_key, filename, content_type, size_bytes, and the sha256 of the file
- output: document_id, upload_url, method PUT, expires_at
- files: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, PNG or JPG, up to 20 MB. The sha256 must match the bytes.

### request_signoff

Ask a registered professional to do a service and sign it. The company pays 100% up front: the professional's fee plus the HumanPush fee.

- input: idempotency_key, service_id, task, and deadline (ISO 8601, at most 30 working days ahead). Optional: document_ids, professional_id, on_unavailable, backup_list, replacement_criteria, max_extension_working_days.
- on_unavailable is chosen now. only_this_professional refunds. backup_list asks your list in order. propose gives you candidates and 15 minutes to choose.
- Omit professional_id to let HumanPush route the request.
- output: review_id, status, the amount, and in the sandbox a pay page
- price: Price on request
- sandbox: pretend money, free

### get_status

Current status, deadline and next action. When you must choose a replacement, the candidates are included.

- input: review_id from request_signoff
- output: status, next_action, deadline, payment, is_final, and the candidates when the status is choose_replacement

### choose_replacement

When get_status says choose_replacement, pick one of the candidates within 15 minutes. After that the payment is refunded.

- input: idempotency_key, review_id, professional_id
- output: the updated status

### respond_to_result

After delivery, accept or dispute. Silence for 72 hours counts as accept. The first dispute lets the professional repair once. The second dispute asks another professional from the same register. You pay that review fee up front.

- input: idempotency_key, review_id, and action (accept or dispute). Optional: reason, and feedback with two yes/no answers (met_service, responsive).
- output: the updated status

### cancel_signoff

Cancel. Free until the professional accepts. After that, 25% of the professional's fee stays with the professional, or 50% once half the lead time has passed. The rest, including the HumanPush fee, is refunded. Not possible after delivery.

- input: idempotency_key, review_id, reason
- output: status cancelled, the fee kept, and the refund

### get_result

The outcome, the signed result, and once it is final the proof. Pass that proof to verify_proof, or to anyone who needs to check it.

- input: review_id
- output: the signed result and the proof. Before a delivery, the call reports that nothing has been delivered yet.

### get_events

The signed, hash-chained events of one review, oldest first. Use since_seq to fetch only new ones.

- input: review_id, and since_seq if you only want events after that sequence number
- output: events. Each event has a hash, the previous hash, and a signature. Once anchored, it also has a Merkle path.

### verify_proof

Check a HumanPush proof yourself: the signature, every event hash and signature, every Merkle path, and the anchor.

- input: the proof object from get_result
- output: valid true or false, and the problems when it does not check out
- keys: https://mcp.humanpush.nl/.well-known/humanpush-keys.json

## Request lifecycle

You choose what happens if a professional is unavailable when you call request_signoff. After that the request moves on by itself. When you chose propose, you still pick the replacement.

States on get_status:

- awaiting_payment. Next action: principal_pays. The company pays 100% up front. In the sandbox the pay page uses pretend money.
- awaiting_professional. Next action: wait_for_professional. The professional can accept inside the window in the service terms.
- choose_replacement. Pick a candidate with choose_replacement within 15 minutes.
- cancelled. You cancelled. What comes back is in cancel_signoff.
- refunded. Final. The payment comes back, including the HumanPush fee.

After a delivery, respond_to_result is how you accept or dispute. get_result then returns the signed work and, once final, the proof.

If the professional declines, is unavailable, or misses the deadline, on_unavailable runs on its own. An extension set in max_extension_working_days is applied first. only_this_professional refunds. backup_list offers the request to the next person on your list. propose opens choose_replacement.

If nobody delivers, the payment is refunded in full, including the HumanPush fee. That follows when the only professional does not take the work, when a backup list runs out, or when you do not choose a replacement in time.

Every review keeps a signed hash-chained event log. Each event stores the previous hash, its own hash, and an ed25519 signature. The sandbox anchors batches of those events on its own chain. get_events returns the log. verify_proof checks the signature, the hashes, the Merkle path and the anchor. You can run that check yourself. The public key is at https://mcp.humanpush.nl/.well-known/humanpush-keys.json.

## Payment

- The company pays 100% upfront.
- There is no split payment. The amount is the professional's fee plus the HumanPush fee.
- Sandbox: pretend money, free.

## Proof

Every final result includes verifiable proof of who signed, when, and that the signer was listed in the public register. The proof is the signed hash chain and the anchor. Anyone can check that proof independently.
